desc.map: Explore every seder, masechet, perek, and mishnah, with your progress along the way.
desc.perek: Make Shas yours — your own names, notes, and memory cues for every perek.
desc.progress: Track your streak and how much of Shas you've learned so far.
desc.chevrusa: Pair up one-on-one with a study partner.
desc.chabura: Start or join a group learning together, with or without a rebbe.
desc.sedarim: Drag the six sedarim — or one seder's masechtot — into their correct order.
desc.mishna: Read a real mishnah and locate it: seder and masechet, with perek as bonus.
desc.sort: Sort all 63 masechtot into the seder each one belongs to.
desc.recall: Type every masechet you can remember, by seder or by all of Shas.
desc.dash: Steer each masechet into its seder before it reaches the end of the road.
desc.resources: Printable worksheets for practicing Shas structure away from the screen.
